title: City Donuts & Café · 24-hour donut shop · New Orleans
description: Open 24 hours on S Claiborne. Glazed beignets, a full donut case, and a kitchen doing shrimp and grits at any hour.
name: City Donuts & Café

hero.kicker: Donuts, beignets & a 24-hour kitchen · 3301 S Claiborne Ave
hero.headline: Hot donuts at three in the morning, and a kitchen that never once closes.
hero.sub: A donut counter and kitchen on S Claiborne that never closes, not on Sundays and not on holidays. Come for the glazed beignets, stay because the café side does breakfast and fried chicken too.

paragraphs: City Donuts sits on S Claiborne with a neon sign in the window that says HOT DONUTS NOW, and it means it at whatever hour you happen to read it. The case runs the length of the counter: glazed, chocolate, iced and sprinkled, filled, and the fried apple and cherry pies stacked in their own tray. A donut shop that never closes is close to a public utility in this part of town.

The café half is the part people underrate. Shrimp and grits come out in a foam box with the shrimp piled on and green onion over the top, the breakfast plate is eggs and grits and sausage and toast, and there is fried chicken if it turns out to be that kind of night. What regulars keep writing about, though, is the glazed beignet. It is not the powdered kind and it is not trying to be.

facts: Open 24 hours, seven days a week
Donut case out front, beignets and fried pies made through the night
Full café menu: breakfast plates, shrimp and grits, fried chicken
Drip coffee and espresso drinks, lattes included
Parking lot on site, wheelchair accessible entrance and restroom
address_display: 3301 S Claiborne Ave, New Orleans, LA 70125

order.name: Glazed Beignets
order.blurb: Square, glazed, handed over hot in a foam box. Not the powdered kind. This is the one people come back for.

order.name: Shrimp and Grits
order.blurb: Shrimp piled over smooth grits with green onion. Reviewers keep landing on the word flavorful, and it is a lot of food.

order.name: Iced Donuts
order.blurb: Pink, white, sprinkled, decorated by hand in the morning. Pick out four and they will box them for you.

order.name: Fried Chicken and Fries
order.blurb: Out of the kitchen at whatever hour you want it, which is the whole point of this place.

tip.text: The case is fullest overnight and again just after dawn, when the fryer has been running and nothing has been sitting. If you want the glazed beignets hot, that is the window.

getting_here: 3301 S Claiborne Ave, Uptown, with the lot out front
Free parking on site, and Claiborne runs you there from Uptown or the CBD in ten minutes
